summary: @servicetitan/cp-ui preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, extracts and chmods the Bun binary in a temp directory, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-compiled JavaScript blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array + rotation obfuscation (shuffle function `WV8StW`, mixed hex/character string array). The package advertises itself as a React UI component library (`main:./dist/index.js`, components/hooks/stores under src/ and dist/); the obfuscated payload is not referenced anywhere in the library sources and only fires via the preinstall dropper. Using a second-language runtime to execute an opaque bundle at install time under an established company scope is consistent with a compromised-maintainer publish rather than the library's declared purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
